description:
Descrição da vaga

NaSmarthis, a presença de mulheres na tecnologia não é apenas um incentivo — é parte essencial da nossa cultura.

Acreditamos em uma transformação que vai além do digital: uma transformação de mentalidade, de paradigmas e de oportunidades. Nossa trajetória como empresa de tecnologia é pautada pela pluralidade de ideias, pela valorização da diversidade e pelo compromisso com um futuro mais justo e inclusivo.

Com o objetivo de reduzir o gap de gênero no setor, desenvolvemos diversas iniciativas para atrair, capacitar e valorizar profissionais mulheres em tecnologia. Seguímos avançando com responsabilidade e consistência em busca do nosso objetivo de compor metade do nosso quadro com mulheres.

Também criamos o programa Sobre Elas — um espaço de troca, escuta e fortalecimento da presença feminina na área tech. Com encontros online, promovemos discussões sobre liderança, carreira, síndrome da impostora, desafios estruturais e outros temas essenciais para a equidade de gênero no mercado. Sabemos que ainda há muito a ser feito, e seguimos investindo em estratégias de desenvolvimento, retenção e protagonismo feminino, fortalecendo um ambiente seguro, inclusivo e colaborativo.

O processo seletivo:

Acreditamos que um processo seletivo transparente e respeitoso é parte fundamental de uma boa experiência. Por isso, compartilhamos desde o início as etapas de avaliação:

  • Primeiro encontro: alinhamento cultural
  • Teste de habilidades: avaliação técnica
  • Segundo encontro: conversa com a liderança

E você pode contar com um retorno em cada etapa. Sabemos a importância do feedback para o desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional, independentemente do resultado.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Seu trabalho será:

  • Atuar em equipe no desenvolvimento e entrega de soluções de automação para clientes em processo de transformação digital;
  • Colocar em prática sua paixão por tecnologia e programação em projetos de alto impacto.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que você precisa ter:

  • Conhecimento em alguma linguagem de programação (ex: .NET, Python, PHP, Java, C#, VBA, VBScript etc.);
  • Inglês intermediário (leitura e compreensão).

Excelente se tiver:

  • Conhecimento em Machine Learning, Business Intelligence ou Robotic Process Automation (RPA);
  • Familiaridade com Excel avançado.

Informações adicionais

Descubra os benefícios de serSmarther:

  • Participação nos lucros e resultados
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico
  • Cartão de benefícios flexível
  • TotalPass
  • Acesso ao Zenklub
  • Programa de idiomas
  • Parceria com a FIAP
  • Trabalho híbrido
  • Treinamentos contínuos
  • Plano de carreira estruturado
  • Horário flexível
  • Programa de mentoria
  • Licença parental estendida
  • Auxílio-creche

Nossas Conquistas:

  • Great Place to Work – Fomos reconhecidos como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil, com destaque também no estado do Rio de Janeiro. Isso é reflexo de um ambiente que valoriza as pessoas e investe continuamente em cultura organizacional.
  • UiPath Diamond Partner – Somos a única empresa da América Latina a alcançar o mais alto nível de parceria global com a UiPath, o que reforça nossa excelência técnica e compromisso com qualidade.
  • Programa Scale-Up Endeavor – Fomos selecionados para o programa da Endeavor que acelera empresas com alto potencial de crescimento e impacto no mercado.

Onde estamos:

Temos presença global com escritórios em Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Miami, Buenos Aires, Madrid e Perth . Nosso modelo de trabalho remoto integra colaboradores de diferentes regiões com uma cultura forte e conectada — promovendo momentos de troca, diversão e desenvolvimento comohappy hours, jogos online e rodas de conversa.

Com uma trajetória de mais de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A . está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.

Nossas +1300 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.

A área de Infraestrutura é responsável por sustentar toda a conectividade da companhia, abrangendo escritórios, lojas e centros de distribuição (CDs).

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Monitorar a saúde da rede (LAN, WAN, Wi‑Fi, VPN, SD‑WAN);
  • Identificar e tratar degradações de performance, latência e perda de pacotes;
  • Verificar disponibilidade de links, equipamentos e serviços de rede;
  • Atuar na análise e resolução de incidentes de média complexidade;
  • Diagnosticar problemas de conectividade (camadas L2, L3 e L4);
  • Analisar rotas, VLANs, NAT, ACLs, DNS e DHCP;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de segurança (SecOps);
  • Garantir segregação de redes (VLANs, zonas de segurança);

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Conhecimento em modelos OSI e TCP/IP;
  • Noções de endereçamento IPv4/IPv6, CIDR, e subnetting;
  • Experiência em configuração e troubleshooting de redes (VLANs, STP, EtherChannel, LACP, ACLs);
  • Domínio em protocolos como ARP, ICMP, TCP, UDP e NAT;
  • Experiência com firewalls, VPNs e Switches;
  • Conhecimento básico de QoS, roteamento estático e dinâmico, e troubleshooting de tráfego.

Será um diferencial, caso você tenha:

  • Experiência no ramo do varejo;
  • Conhecimento em ambientes de nuvem (Azure, GCP, OCI);
  • Conhecimento em SDWAN;
  • Familiaridade com Azure ExpressRoute e Security Groups em nuvem.

description:
Overview

Oportunidade disponível para contratação híbrida nos escritórios de São Paulo, Campinas, Rio de Janeiro e Curitiba.

Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você.

Em Impostos, estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando organizações a prosperar em uma era de mudanças rápidas. Oferecemos serviços em todas as disciplinas tributárias e combinamos nosso conhecimento e experiência com as pessoas e as melhores plataformas de tecnologia; e isso nos torna um parceiro ideal para as necessidades relacionadas a impostos sobre transações, impostos internacionais e questões fiscais relacionadas a pessoas, conformidade e relatórios, entre outros.

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como uma pessoa Assessora Tributária Sênior de Preços de Transferência você será parte da área de TAX atuando na definição de preços dos produtos produzidos no exterior e vendidos no Brasil. Prestando assessoria tributária para atendimento as regras de preços de transferência realizando revisão, documentação, gerenciamento e defesa das políticas de preços de transferência, além da preparação de cálculos e documentos pertinentes para o cumprimento de obrigações principais e acessórias, assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Realizar análises de preços de transferência sob a ótica das diretrizes da OCDE;
  • Coordenar projetos globais ou regionais de documentação de preços de transferência envolvendo diversas jurisdições - CbCR, Master File, Local File e Benchmark análises);
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento, implementação e monitoramento de políticas de preços de transferência para empresas multinacionais brasileiras e internacionais;
  • Participar de projetos de auditoria para realizar revisões sob a ótica de preços de transferência;
  • Desenvolver a equipe nas melhores práticas de preços de transferência;
  • Desenvolver análises críticas;
  • Entender as linhas de serviço da EY e incentivar, de forma ativa, as pessoas da equipe a contribuírem com ideias e identificar oportunidades de aplicação dos serviços que podemos oferecer aos nossos clientes;
  • Auxiliar as equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos e exposições.

Por que você?
Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua:

  • Experiência na área de preços de transferência (in house ou Big4);
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente;
  • Graduação em economia, contabilidade ou administração;
  • Habilidade na comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Habilidade no trabalho em equipe e liderança.

Poderá ser um diferencial, caso você tenha os seguintes requisitos:

  • Conhecimento em espanhol;
  • Habilidades analíticas financeiras e contábeis e domínio do pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint);
  • Vivência em projetos de suporte a auditoria, compliance e planejamento tributário;
  • Conhecimento em Digital TAX.

O que oferecemos

Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Gympass, PLR, e muito mais. Clique aqui e conheça nosso universo de benefícios .

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias. Segundo o Great Place to Work 2022, somos a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+ do Brasil, e a 2a melhor empresa para Mulheres e para Pessoas Pretas. Assim, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.


THE POSITION

Reporting to the Head of Broadcast FIFA27 and Senior Partnerships Services Manager in Zurich HQ, the Senior Media Partnerships Services Manager FIFA27 will assume crucial responsibility in overseeing and facilitating the provision of services to FIFA’s Media Partners.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee and coordinate the preparation of all aspects of services provided to FIFA’s Media Partners in the Host Country, excluding host broadcast production. This encompassing role includes accommodation, accreditation, catering, customs, filming permits, frequency licensing, logistics, transportation, venue access control, visas, work permits, site visits, and more.
  • Contribute hiring and supervising the Media Partnerships Services Manager. Coordinate an event team consisting of 4-6 skilled staff members based at different stadiums.
  • Maintain effective communication and work closely with the Zurich-based Relations and Services department.
  • Forge collaborative partnership with the Host Broadcast Production colleagues to determine and implement optimal unilateral services across all broadcast venues (Stadiums, International Broadcast Coordination Center, FIFA Fan Fests, and beyond).
  • Cultivate enduring relationships with key functional areas of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, fostering synergies and ensuring smooth operation of essential services.
  • Work hand in hand with the Relations management team to address the specific needs of Media Partners during their visits to the Host Cities, providing comprehensive support throughout the preparation phase.
  • Support organising various workshops as well as venue tours.
  • Manage and coordinate services for numerous operations and milestone events leading up to the tournament, starting with the Draw in December 2026.
  • Contribute actively to the seamless delivery of services during the tournament, always ensuring the highest standards of excellence.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Master’s degree or similar higher education in Business and/or Sports Management or equivalent education.

Experience

  • 5-7 years of experience in a similar role.
  • Experience in the Sports industry is an advantage.
  • Experience in Broadcast environment is an advantage.
  • Experience of working in Brazil and knowledge of local culture will be an added benefit.
  • Experience in major sports events, such as the FIFA World Cup ™ or other FIFA events will be an asset.

Skills & Competencies

  • ACCOUNTABILITY: We are looking for accountable individuals—people who take ownership of their responsibilities, follow through on commitments, and drive results with integrity. Individuals must be ready to step up, be reliable, and make a meaningful impact.
  • LEADERSHIP: We are seeking individuals with leadership qualities—those who inspire others, lead by example, and guide internal/external teams with confidence, empathy, and purpose to achieve set objectives under tight timelines.
  • INITIATIVE: We are seeking people with strong initiative—self-starters who take proactive steps, anticipate challenges, and go beyond what’s expected without waiting to be asked – who have the capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.
  • DECISION MAKING: We are seeking decisive individuals, with the ability to identify critical situations and swiftly make decisions, who take initiative and calculated risks, who explore alternative solutions, and react promptly to unforeseen circumstances.
  • INNOVATION: We are looking for innovative thinkers—individuals who challenge the status quo, bring fresh ideas, and find creative solutions to complex problems.
  • VISION: We are looking for visionary individuals—people who see the bigger picture, formulate strategic plans, think long-term, perceive the organization’s global environmental impact and help shape bold ideas into reality.
  • INCLUSIVITY: We seek individuals who love teamwork, actively listen, embrace diverse perspectives, and help build collaborative, respectful teams.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Fluent in English and (Brazilian) Portuguese. Any other language is a plus.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.) and online collaboration tools.
  • This position requires frequent travel to participate in meetings and venue tours.

  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Job Purpose

The Part-Time Program Manager provides operational, coordination, and implementation support across multiple externally funded grants and initiatives. This role supports the Principal Investigator and project teams by managing day-to-day grant activities, coordinating student projects, tracking progress toward deliverables, and ensuring timely and effective implementation of grant-funded programs. The position plays a critical role in translating funded research and community‑based projects into actionable outcomes.

Supervisory Authority

Nature And Scope

The Part-Time Program Manager works closely with faculty investigators, students, community partners, and institutional offices to support the successful execution of multiple grants. The role requires strong organizational skills, clear communication, and the ability to manage overlapping timelines across projects focused on research, education, community engagement, and technology innovation.

  • Maintain organized project documentation and shared resources
  • Assist with preparation of internal updates and external reports
  • Coordinate meetings, workshops, and project‑related events as needed

Core Competencies

  • Project and program coordination
  • Grant administration support
  • Student supervision and mentoring
  • Written and verbal communication
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Collaborative and team‑oriented approach

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred

  • Experience working with undergraduate or graduate students
  • Strong organizational and administrative skills

title: Lead Learning Designer
description:
About BrainBuffet

BrainBuffet is an EdTech curriculum production company focused on creating certification-aligned learning experiences that prepare students for real-world careers. We design high-quality courses and resources for industry certifications such as Adobe, Microsoft, Unity, Cisco, and Intuit, combining strong instructional design, hands‑on learning, and practical skill development. Our mission is to empower educators and students through engaging, accessible, and effective digital learning that builds creativity, confidence, and career‑ready skills.

Role Overview

Lead Learning Designer to own the pre‑production and instructional design strategy of our certification courses. This role sits at the intersection of pedagogy, content strategy, and cross‑functional collaboration. You’ll be responsible for shaping courses from the ground up—working closely with the Product Manager, the Creative Director, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), the Project Manager, and Curriculum Consultants to ensure every course is accurate, well‑structured, and aligned with certification requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Exam & Content Analysis

  • Analyze certification objective domains to understand the exam structure, and to gather the knowledge students will need to succeed.
  • Translate exam requirements into effective learning strategies and course structure.

Course Ideation & Strategy

  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Creative Directors, and Consultants to support course ideation and development.
  • Conduct desk research to understand the topic area, target audience, industry trends, key players, opportunities, and challenges.
  • Participate in stakeholder handoffs and ensure alignment from concept to execution.

Partner Selection & Onboarding

  • Support the selection and onboarding of external partners:
  • Curriculum Consultants (subject‑matter experts who validate content accuracy)
  • Instructors / SMEs (on‑camera educators who record course content)
  • Review instructor samples to ensure teaching style, clarity, and tone align with BrainBuffet standards.
  • Lead onboarding for SMEs and contributors by sharing guidelines, templates, workflows, and quality expectations.

Pre Production Ownership

  • You are accountable for instructional pre‑production and content structure, ensuring all educational components are clearly defined and prepared before production begins.
  • Partner with Consultants and the Creative Director to draft and refine the course outline.
  • Define the instructional structure, scope, and sequence to ensure alignment with learning objectives and product goals.
  • Develop or approve instructional guidelines, templates, scripts, and blueprints for:
  • Written materials (worksheets, quizzes, lesson plans, and supporting resources)
  • Collaborate with the Creative Director to ensure instructional plans align with creative vision and production approach.
  • Review early instructional drafts with Education, Editing, and Creative teams, incorporating feedback as appropriate.
  • Ensure instructional accuracy and pedagogical integrity in collaboration with Consultants and SMEs.
  • Provide instructional input on video samples and early production materials in partnership with the Creative Director.

Content Review & Quality Control

  • Review and refine instructional scripts and recorded videos, providing actionable feedback to instructors and clear notes for the editing team (cuts, cleanup, and improvements).
  • Guide the team in reviewing the instructional structure of written deliverables (including quizzes, video pop‑up questions, endcards), ensuring alignment with the course blueprint and supporting consistency, clarity, and pedagogical integrity.
  • Review and approve written deliverables, including quizzes, worksheets, handbooks, activities, and lesson plans.
  • Review and approve SME deliverables, cleanup runs, and ensure alignment with established standards and workflows across modules and videos.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation and status updates throughout the production process.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Create and maintain course syllabi that define structure, scope, and instructional direction for each course.
  • Train and mentor new Learning Designers and Learning Experience Designers.
  • Lead and support the education team, fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Act as the main point of contact for SMEs and Consultants regarding content, pedagogy, and educational practices.

Requirements

  • Strong background in instructional design, curriculum development, or learning experience design.
  • Proven experience designing structured courses with clear learning objectives and measurable outcomes.
  • Professional proficiency in spoken and written English.
  • Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills across cross‑functional teams.
  • Experience working with subject‑matter experts (SMEs) to develop accurate, instructionally sound content.
  • Ability to manage complex workflows and own instructional pre‑production from planning through production readiness.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience, including mentoring instructional designers, setting quality standards, and providing clear feedback.
  • Ability to guide, prioritize, and align the education design team, ensuring consistency, scalability, and high instructional quality across courses.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in EdTech, digital learning, or curriculum production environments.
  • Experience creating instructional blueprints, scripts, templates, and structured course frameworks.
  • Experience collaborating with creative and production teams in video-based learning environments.
  • Familiarity with technical subject matter such as creative software, IT, business, or certification pathways.
  • Experience designing certification‑aligned or standards‑aligned courses.

title: Supervisor de Manutenção
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac(AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Tax Sr. Associate Credit Saison Brazil • Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

About the Company

Credit Saison Brazil (“CSBR”) is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early‑stage start‑up investment and M&A / joint venture.

Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan’s largest non‑bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.

Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you’re passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi‑cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let’s contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.

About the Role

Tax Calculation & Compliance : Expertise in the calculation and review of all major federal taxes : IRPJ / CSLL (Annual / Quarterly Actual Profit Lucro Real and Presumed Profit Lucro Presumido), and PIS / COFINS (Cumulative and Non‑Cumulative regimes).

Deep knowledge of federal withholding taxes (IRRF, CSRF, INSSRF) and their accounting reconciliation.

Experience with tax benefits and fiscal incentives + Tax Credits.

Auxiliary Obligations — Extensive experience in the preparation, review, and timely submission of federal and state Tax obligations, including : DCTF, ECF, EFD Contributions, EFD Reinf, ECD, Per / Dcomp, GIA, SPED Fiscal, E-financeira, Dimp.

Tax Credits & Recovery : Proven track record in identifying and processing tax credits, including claims for undue or overpayment, IRPJ / CSLL negative balances, and PIS / COFINS credits (Restitution and Reimbursement requests).

Audit & Litigation Support — Experience managing the Tax Audit calendar and serving as the primary point of contact for external audits.

Ability to analyze and respond to official notices, subpoenas (intimações), decision‑making orders (despachos decisórios), and internal preliminary tax reviews from the Brazilian Federal Revenue (Receita Federal do Brasil).

Tax Planning & Strategy : Knowledge of Transfer Pricing (specifically for Services) and the ability to act as a Tax Business Partner to internal controls (risk management) and international finance teams (supporting international expansion, and local registration).

Financial Reconciliation — Advanced skill in performing detailed fiscal cross‑checks (ECF x EFD Contribuições x DCTF x Apurações x DARFs) and reconciling tax‑related general ledger accounts (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, IRRF, PCC).

Collaboration & Communication — Excellent interpersonal skills and a collaborative attitude, focused on sharing knowledge, working effectively in a team environment, and ensuring effective internal customer service.

Requirements

  • Over 10 years of progressive experience in the fiscal and tax field, with expertise gained across diverse sectors including Technology / Services and Finance.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or Law and specialization / Post‑Graduate certification in Taxation.
  • Advanced proficiency and practical expertise in leading ERP systems.
  • Native or bilingual proficiency in Portuguese & English (both verbal and written).

title: Accreditation Operations Senior Manager
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. The tournament requires a highly coordinated, secure, and reliable accreditation operation across all venues and official facilities. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Accreditation Operations Senior Manager plays a senior operational leadership role within the FIFA27 Accreditation team, overseeing the coordination and delivery of accreditation operations across the tournament footprint. He/She will be responsible for the end-to-end planning, coordination, and delivery of accreditation operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, ensuring consistent, compliant, and high-quality service delivery across all tournament venues and official facilities.

Reporting to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager, and working in close collaboration with FIFA Zürich Accreditation, Technology, Security, Client Groups, and Venue Operations, the role provides operational leadership, governance, and oversight of accreditation centre operations, badge production and distribution, accreditation venue teams, and service delivery standards.

The role provides oversight and guidance to Accreditation Operations Managers and Coordinators and acts as a senior operational escalation point.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational Planning & Management

  • Manage the overall accreditation operations strategy across all tournament venues and facilities
  • Define and implement accreditation operational policies, procedures, workflows and service standards in alignment with FIFA requirements
  • Establish and maintain operational timelines, resourcing plans, and risk mitigation measures.
  • Contribute to tournament readiness activities, including operational testing and scenario planning.

Venue & Facilities Management

  • Plan and oversee the delivery of fully equipped Accreditation Centres, including overlay, FF&E, technology, power, lighting, and connectivity.
  • Supervise the setup, operation, and dismantling of accreditation centres and badge distribution points.
  • Ensure venue teams are trained, resourced, and aligned with central accreditation policies and procedures.
  • Coordinate the Accreditation volunteers planning, including shift structures and service levels.
  • Supervise day‑day accreditation centre operations across all venues and facilities.

Badge Production & Distribution Oversight

  • Define requirements and manage procurement of accreditation consumables in line with FIFA27 Inc. standards and timelines.
  • Oversee badge production, quality control, secure storage, logistics, and distribution.
  • Implement robust stock controls, audit processes, and reporting mechanisms across all accreditation facilities.

Team Leadership & Support

  • Lead and manage a team of Accreditation Operations Managers and Coordinators.
  • Support and guide venue-based accreditation managers, temporary staff and volunteers.
  • Provide training, coaching, and performance oversight to ensure consistent service delivery and operational excellence.

Issue Resolution & Stakeholder Support

  • Act as the final escalation point for complex operational issues related to badge issuance, access rights, or client service.
  • Work closely with the Accreditation Systems, Client Group Managers and Coordinators, Security and Technology teams to resolve operational challenges efficiently.

Compliance, Security & Governance

  • Ensure all accreditation operations comply with FIFA access control policies, data protection requirements, and security protocols.
  • Support venue zoning implementation and access rights validation.
  • Ensure accurate documentation, secure handling of materials, and operational compliance at all times.

Monitoring & Reporting

  • Track operational performance and provide regular operational updates to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to post‑event reporting, lessons learned, and operational debriefs.

YOUR PROFILE

Education & Experience

  • University degree or equivalent higher education in Event Management, Operations, or related field.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in accreditation and/or major event operations.
  • Proven experience managing venue operations and large‑scale logistics in complex event environments.
  • Familiarity with accreditation systems and access control processes.
  • Experience working in multi‑lingual, high‑pressure environments.
  • Experience with FIFA or major international sporting events or with accreditation Systems is a plus.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong operational leadership and coordination skills.
  • Excellent organisational and logistical planning skills.
  • High attention to detail and operational discipline.
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross‑functional coordination skills.
  • Ability to operate calmly and decisively in time‑critical situations.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, Project) and planning tools.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Knowledge of 3D modelling or planning tools is a plus.

Additional Requirements

  • Eligibility to work in Brazil.
  • Willingness to relocate to Rio de Janeiro for the duration of the contract.
  • Flexibility to work extended hours during critical operational phases.

title: Care Coordinator
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff \"for fit\" makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.


Here Is What We Offer



  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements

  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match

  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths

  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture


Join Howard University and thrive with us!


Benefits page:


Basic Functions


To provide coordination of client-centered services that link clients with substance use disorder, behavioral health, and general health with coordinated care and psychosocial services. Working closely and collaboratively with the HUH inpatient and Consultation‑Liaison and Addiction Medicine Consult services and the ambulatory Mental Health Clinic (Behavioral Health Clinic) teams, the Care Coordinator assesses clients’ needs and support systems; facilitates timely, coordinated access to and continuation of medically appropriate substance use disorder, behavioral health, and general health care health and support services; assists in expediting appropriate discharge from inpatient facilities, as medically appropriate, and assists in preventing unnecessary hospitalizations; and establishes and maintains relations with case managers, healthcare providers, social services and other agency representatives to bridge the gaps between health, social service, entitlements and other systems.


Principal Accountabilities



  • Assists in development and implements protocols for coordinating the substance use disorder, behavioral health, and general health services for individual clients or patients with substance use or co‑occurring psychiatric and substance use disorders.

  • Provides care coordination services to a caseload of patients/clients, as assigned by the PI, Project Director, or Care Manager Coordinator.

  • Operates as a liaison between the Departments of Psychiatry and Community and Family Medicine.

  • Social Work and the DC Department of Health and other community groups.

  • Ensures that patients receive necessary follow‑up substance use or psychiatric disorder treatment and medical treatments.

  • May accompany patients to the initial or follow‑up visits and may help arrange transportation and scheduling of appointments.

  • Conducts intake and follow up assessments of clients’/patients’ behavioral health and medical/functional status; structural vulnerabilities; psychological; educational; financial; and individual support needs.

  • Reviews all initial client bio‑psychosocial assessments and reassessments.

  • Attends department trainings and meetings relevant in ongoing effort to increase knowledge and skills to work effectively with clients.

  • Attends annual and mandatory compliance Program training, including the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPPA) Privacy training, maintains adherence to the Health Sciences Compliance Program, the Howard University Code of Ethics and the Health Sciences Standards of Conduct.

  • Works on behalf of patients receiving medications for opioid use disorder treatment to improve the system of care by identifying service gaps and identifying services that are needed and ensuring that these services are provided in a courteous and dignified manner.

  • Maintains confidentiality of patients, their families and the staff.

  • Performs other related duties as assigned.


Core Competencies



  • Knowledge of the care needed for individuals receiving MOUD or other substance use disorder treatment.

  • Knowledge of community resources to establish referral systems with community agencies to facilitate coordinated management plans for patients and their families.

  • Ability to express ideas clearly using appropriate language in communicating with a wide range of health, socioeconomic, and cultural groups.

  • Competence in both oral and written English.

  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with clients and their family members and other treatment or service providers; physicians, staff, University and Hospital personnel, and the general public.

  • Proficiency in both oral and written English.


Minimum Requirements


A Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, or a related field, or 2 or more years of experience in the field.


Compliance Salary Range Disclosure


$46,700- $52,700

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world‑building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper‑focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service—our AI‑powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game‑changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50‑100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance—combining bold visual storytelling with data‑informed design decisions. You’ll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short‑form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high‑volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data‑backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do:

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high‑tempo creative strategy and direction for full‑funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short‑form video.

  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb‑stop rate, hold rate, and click‑through rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

  • Cross‑Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile‑first videos, and storyboards for short‑form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy‑only folks.

  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short‑form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short‑form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low‑fidelity creative.

  • You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy‑only folks will not be a fit.

  • You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb‑stop rate, 3‑second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

  • You already use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI‑assisted elements, not just experiments.

  • You’re an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients.

  • You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand‑holding.

  • Deep in Figma including Auto Layout, Components, and handoff. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative ad experience.

  • No portfolio link or no performance context.

  • Strategy‑only with no hands‑on design ability.

  • Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in‑office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Creative Strategist (Performance Creative)
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next‑generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive‑level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e‑commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest‑growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world‑building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper‑focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service—our AI‑powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game‑changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50‑100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance—combining bold visual storytelling with data‑informed design decisions. You’ll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short‑form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high‑volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data‑backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do:

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high‑tempo creative strategy and direction for full‑funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short‑form video.

  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb‑stop rate, hold rate, and click‑through rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

  • Cross‑Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile‑first videos, and storyboards for short‑form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy‑only folks.

  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short‑form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short‑form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low‑fidelity creative.

  • You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy‑only folks will not be a fit.

  • You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb‑stop rate, 3‑second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

  • You already use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI‑assisted elements, not just experiments.

  • You’re an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients.

  • You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand‑holding.

  • Deep in Figma including Auto Layout, Components, and handoff. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative ad experience.

  • No portfolio link or no performance context.

  • Strategy‑only with no hands‑on design ability.

  • Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in‑office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: CRO Expert
description:
Company Introduction:

Apex is a growing agency focused on Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), aimed at boosting client sales without increasing ad budgets. We work with top e-commerce brands to enhance their websites, using data and proven strategies to drive growth.

With a solid record of delivering results, we combine technical skills with a focus on improving user experience. As we expand, we offer opportunities to work with a talented team, solving challenges and applying advanced CRO methods.

If you’re looking to make a difference and help e-commerce businesses grow, alongside a team of driven professionals, consider joining the Apex team.

About the Role

The Conversion Rate Optimization Expert is responsible for enhancing the performance of our clients’ websites by implementing data-driven strategies that maximize their conversion rates.

This position plays a key role in analyzing user behavior, identifying optimization opportunities, and implementing changes to improve overall site performance. You will collaborate closely with copywriters, designers, web developers, and other team members.

Your responsibilities will include developing Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) strategies for our clients, auditing their websites to identify optimization opportunities, running A/B and multivariate tests to determine the changes needed, and working with our internal teams to execute, monitor, and further improve the results of the optimizations implemented.

Mission Statement:

The primary mission of our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert is to drive measurable improvements in our clients’ e-commerce website performance by implementing tailored CRO strategies. This will involve working directly on optimizing brand websites and using data-driven insights to enhance user experiences, maximize conversion rates, and deliver real business growth to our clients.

General responsibilities:

The responsibilities of our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert include, but are not limited to:

  • Developing and implementing tailored, data-driven backend CRO strategies for our agency’s clients to enhance their website performance and maximize conversion rates
  • Performing thorough brand audits of clients’ websites to identify areas for improvement
  • Conducting in-depth analysis of user behavior using analytical CRO tools, user feedback, heatmaps, and session recordings to identify trends and opportunities for optimization
  • Designing, executing, and managing A/B and multivariate tests to validate hypotheses and measure the impact of the CRO changes implemented
  • Optimizing brands’ landing and product pages, checkout flows, and overall website architecture
  • Collaborating closely with copywriters, designers, and developers to implement best practices and innovative solutions that enhance the user experience and reduce funnel friction points
  • Monitoring and reporting on the performance of CRO initiatives, providing actionable insights and strategic recommendations for continuous improvement
  • Translating complex data and test results into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for clients to ensure that they can make informed decisions
  • Staying up-to-date with the latest trends and tools in the CRO, e-commerce, and digital marketing industries to continuously refine your own strategies and practices
  • Maintaining thorough documentation of all CRO projects, including test results and client interactions, to track progress and outcomes
  • Assisting in the development of CRO case studies and success stories for marketing purposes

Overall, the Conversion Rate Optimization Expert will play an important role in driving measurable growth for our clients by leveraging data-driven insights to optimize their online presence, enhance user experiences, and ultimately increase conversion rates across their e-commerce platforms.

Position specifications:

The Conversion Rate Optimization Expert position includes committing to the following:

  • Full-time commitment while overlapping with our standard office hours (10:00 AM to 6:00 PM UK time)
  • Consistently maintaining an average workload of 40 hours per week
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • A 30-day notice period of one calendar month

About You:

Profile:

As our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert, you need to bring a highly proactive and analytical approach to your work. You should be able to work independently with high levels of reliability, transparency, and trust. You also need the ability to work under pressure and manage multiple clients’ CRO strategies with great attention to detail and the required technical abilities. The ideal person for this role is a rational thinker who enjoys problem-solving, who can work fast and efficiently, and who has excellent communication skills. In addition, good organizational, time management, and analytical skills will help you succeed in this position and work well within our team environment.

Availability and consistency are highly important factors for us, so our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert should display these qualities regarding workload commitments and availability during office hours.

Key traits for this position:

You should demonstrate great attention to detail, strong communication skills, as well as excellent analytical, technical, and problem-solving abilities. A sense of proactivity, hunger for growth, and a consistent, highly communicative work ethic will work in your favor. You will also need a forward-thinking approach to anticipate shifts in user feedback and industry trends, and you should be highly adaptable and open to continuous learning to help you stay ahead in the rapidly evolving e-commerce landscape.

Responsiveness and autonomy will be essential traits for this role.

Key requirements:

The Conversion Rate Optimization Expert position has the following key requirements:

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in the CRO field
  • Proven experience in a similar CRO role, specifically within the e-commerce industry
  • A proven track record of improving conversion rates for e-commerce clients
  • Proficiency in analytical tools such as Google Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, and Convert.com as well as excellent data analysis skills to provide actionable insights to our clients
  • A strong understanding of UX/UI principles and how they affect conversion rates
  • A demonstrated ability to run A/B and multivariate tests from start to finish
  • Experience with e-commerce platforms (such as Shopify, Magento, WooCommerce) and the specific challenges involved in optimizing the user’s experience
  • Being familiar with heatmaps, session recordings, and user feedback tools
  • Strong communication skills for effectively presenting test results and recommendations to the team and the clients (direct client communication will not be a requirement of the role, at least not as originally intended)
  • A proactive attitude with a strong focus on delivering high-quality results
  • Being able to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team
  • Being able to handle multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
  • An excellent attention to detail and a commitment to producing high-quality work
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to finding solutions
  • Familiarity with working autonomously and managing your own time independently and effectively
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or PC
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English (You must be fluent in English, although English doesn't have to be your native language)
  • Being open to receiving feedback and constructive criticism and improving on it
  • Must be available and responsive during our office hours (10:00 AM to 6:00 PM UK time)
  • Must be able to consistently work full-time

LiveMode Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Join to apply for the Produtor(a) de Conteúdo | Esportes Olímpicos – Redes Sociais (RJ) role at LiveMode

O que nos move? Claro, a paixão por esportes é indiscutível, mas também somos grandes amantes de inovação constante! Buscamos soluções digitais que conectem clubes, federações, ligas e marcas ao público de forma eficaz e inovadora. Nosso objetivo é construir um ecossistema que sustente o esporte nas próximas décadas, integrando o melhor do digital e da TV. É assim que estamos fazendo história e queremos encontrar mais pessoas que acreditem no potencial do que estamos construindo e queiram fazer parte disso.

Agora, imagina você começar a sua carreira trabalhando com esporte e numa empresa que vem transformando esse mercado?

Como Produtor(a) de Conteúdo | Esportes Olímpicos – Redes Sociais (RJ) , sua missão será planejar, organizar e impulsionar a estratégia de conteúdo e relacionamento com atletas olímpicos, garantindo que a produção, as pautas, os cronogramas e as parcerias evoluam com agilidade, qualidade e alinhamento estratégico , impulsionando não apenas nossa presença no mercado, mas também a forma como o esporte é vivenciado globalmente.

Responsabilidades:

  • Produção e Direção de Conteúdo: Criar e adaptar posts, artes, cortes e vídeos para plataformas diversas, garantindo que cada entrega contribua diretamente para nossos objetivos estratégicos de ampliar alcance, relevância e impacto das narrativas olímpicas.
  • Construção de Narrativas Esportivas: Traduzir jogos, estatísticas, bastidores e momentos marcantes em conteúdos criativos e de alta performance, colaborando com múltiplas áreas para fortalecer nossa presença editorial e aproximar o público dos atletas.
  • Promoção de eventos da CazéTV: Cortes de jogos, Transmissões e Programas em conteúdos olímpicos.
  • Edição Ágil e Autônoma: Utilizar ferramentas de edição para entregar materiais com ritmo, precisão e qualidade, apoiando a inovação contínua na forma como produzimos conteúdo.
  • Coberturas em Tempo Real: Acompanhar competições, transmissões e bastidores, garantindo velocidade, coerência editorial e alinhamento ao posicionamento da CazéTV e da LiveMode.
  • Gestão de Plataformas e Performance: Monitorar tendências, métricas e formatos emergentes, propondo otimizações que fortaleçam nossa estratégia de conteúdo em escala.
  • Planejamento Operacional: Organizar pautas, agendas, cronogramas e rotinas de publicação, atuando como peça central do fluxo entre conteúdo, design, hard news e tecnologia.
  • Conexão com Diferentes Times: Design, audiovisual e transmissões, para garantir consistência com uma entrega estratégica.
  • Interação com Projetos de Automação e IA: Contribuir para iniciativas que integrem automação e inteligência artificial aos processos, elevando eficiência e acelerando entregas.
  • Relacionamento com Atletas e Gestão de Parcerias: Acompanhar o dia a dia dos atletas olímpicos, organizar fluxos de entrega, sugerir pautas, orientar a produtora responsável pelas execuções e garantir que as parcerias evoluam dentro dos prazos e expectativas.

Requisitos necessários:

  • Experiência prévia em Social Media, Conteúdo ou Edição: Especialmente em esporte, entretenimento ou mídia esportiva/TV, devido à urgência e à necessidade de ritmo e familiaridade com ambientes dinâmicos.
  • Domínio de plataformas e cultura digital: Entendimento profundo de formatos, linguagem, timing e comportamento das principais redes sociais.
  • Habilidade de edição de vídeo e imagem: Experiência com CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci, Photoshop e Canva, essencial para entregas rápidas e alinhadas ao padrão de qualidade esperado.
  • Conhecimento e interesse em esportes, especialmente modalidades olímpicas: Fundamental para compreender narrativas, ritmos, temporadas e universos das modalidades e dos atletas.

Diferenciais desejáveis:

  • Experiência com projetos digitais ou cobertura esportiva: Especialmente em ambientes de mídia esportiva, transmissões ou competições.
  • Familiaridade com automações e IA generativa: Para colaborar com fluxos de aceleração e inovação em conteúdo.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado: Útil para interações, pesquisas, compreensão de competições e referências internacionais.

Nossos benefícios:

  • Auxílio Alimentação de R$ 1.250,00 por mês, para utilização em restaurantes, mercados, aplicativos de comida e outros estabelecimentos físicos ou online.
  • Vale Transporte (opcional) caso opte pelo benefício, haverá desconto de 6% do salário bruto, conforme previsto na CLT.
  • Plano de Saúde (Especial – SulAmérica) sem custo mensal para o colaborador, com coparticipação de 10% em consultas e exames. É permitida a inclusão de dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), com custos por conta do colaborador e mesma coparticipação.
  • Plano Odontológico (Mais DOC) sem custo mensal para o colaborador para o plano "Mais Doc", com possibilidade de migração para outros planos (diferença de valor descontada em folha) e inclusão de dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), com desconto em folha.
  • TotalPass e Wellhub (opcionais) o colaborador pode escolher a plataforma que melhor atender às suas necessidades. Ambas oferecem acesso a academias de diversas modalidades, esportes variados e aplicativos de saúde física, mental e financeira.
  • Auxílio-Creche para filhos de até 5 anos e 11 meses, com reembolso de despesas em creches, escolas ou com profissional regularizado (babá ou autônomo).
  • Auxílio para Dependentes PCD para colaboradores que apoiam pessoas com deficiência, mediante apresentação de laudo médico.
  • Seguro de Vida (Prudential) é uma proteção financeira para o colaborador e seus beneficiários em momentos de adversidade. SESC oferece acesso a atividades culturais, esportivas, de lazer, saúde e educação, incentivando um estilo de vida saudável e equilibrado.
  • Open English oferece acesso a cursos de inglês ou espanhol em diversos formatos, com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e familiares.

Nossa cultura

Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte , e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.

SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES ontem, hoje e sempre. Escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo.

SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE não uma família ou uma confraria de amigos. Família a gente não escolhe, mas o time escolhe quem joga. E quando o jogo é grande, não dá pra carregar quem não tá entregando. Aqui, a gente decide pelo que é melhor pra empresa, não pra uma área ou pessoa. Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas.

SOMOS AMBICIOSOS pensamos sempre grande. A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. E é ela que nos leva a quebrar recorde atrás de recorde.

O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional — é o que vai nos ajudar a alcançar nossa missão mais rápido. IA não é extra. É parte central do nosso dia a dia.

Banco de Talentos de Professores - Os Batutinhas

Banco de Talentos de Professores - Os Batutinhas

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de mais de 119 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 85.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.
Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.
Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.
SOBRE O BANCO DE TALENTOS:
Este banco de talentos é para Os Batutinhas, uma de nossas marcas de escola no Brasil. Somos uma escola com mais de 20 anos de história formando as nossas crianças para saírem preparadas para enfrentar os desafios do Ensino Fundamental, apaixonados por literatura e com prazer de investigar o mundo. Baseado na teoria construtivista, o trabalho d’Os Batutinhas é ancorado na visão de que a criança assume o lugar de protagonista no seu processo de aprendizagem, construindo conhecimentos sobre o mundo e sobre si mesma.
Nossa missão é contribuir para a formação de crianças criativas, éticas e conscientes de seus deveres por meio da ampliação do repertório cultural e da formação contínua da equipe. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.
Se você se identifica com a nossa proposta, se inscreva no nosso Banco de Talentos de Professores para Os Batutinhas e assim que surgir uma oportunidade que tenha a ver com o seu perfil, nós entraremos em contato!
RESPONSABILIDADES
O que nossos professores fazem:

  • Planejam as aulas baseadas em materiais pedagógicos;
  • Ministram aulas;
  • Mediam relacionamento entre alunos, famílias e escola;
  • Preparam avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Participam de reuniões pedagógicas e eventos realizados na escola.
REQUISITOS
O que você precisa ter:
  • Formação adequada para a função que deseja.
Será um diferencial se você tiver:
  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.
SAFEGUARDING STATEMENT
O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.
