title: Quality Assurance Engineer – Tieto Tech Consulting (m/f/d)
description:
Overview

Do you have a strong background in quality assurance, a structured approach to testing, and want to join one of the largest technology companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting . Tieto Tech Consulting works as a true partner, solving clients’ toughest technology challenges and delivering reliable outcomes that drive measurable results. By combining engineering excellence with disciplined quality practices, we support customers developing and operating critical digital platforms.

In this role, you will work in close collaboration with product, engineering, and design teams, ensuring high quality, reliability, and scalability of backend services in a modern cloud-based environment.

When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a Quality Assurance Engineer, you will

  • Partner with product, engineering, and design teams to refine user stories, ensuring acceptance criteria are clear, complete, and testable.
  • Conduct daily evaluations of the QA swimlane in JIRA for new feature work and collaborate with engineers to execute test cycles.
  • Design, develop, and document comprehensive test plans and test cases for new and existing backend services.
  • Develop and maintain Postman API tests and automated integration test suites targeting backend services and data flows across AWS components (SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EventBridge).
  • Implement and manage API contract testing to validate integrations and ensure data consistency across internal and external services.
  • Design, execute, and maintain performance, load, and stress tests for critical backend infrastructure to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to define and test security, access control, and compliance requirements (e.g. HIPAA) for backend services handling sensitive data.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to establish continuous quality gates and support safe, frequent deployments.
  • Manage initial release completion, acting as the first quality gate by approving tickets when testing passes or returning them for rework when defects are identified.
  • Collaborate with QA Engineers across squads to ensure a consistent and high-quality experience for both patient- and provider-facing features.

Who we are looking for

  • Experienced QA professional with 5+ years of experience in startup or fast-paced environments, combining strong manual testing skills with automated testing capabilities.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience testing AWS-based backend architectures using Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, and EventBridge .
  • Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or TypeScript for writing and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end-to-end, and component tests .
  • Experience with performance, load, and stress testing applied to backend infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with API contract testing frameworks .
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
  • Familiarity with agile development practices and bug tracking tools (e.g. JIRA, BrowserStack ).
  • Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
  • Detail-oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.

Experience in the healthcare domain is considered an advantage.

As a person, you are a team player who takes responsibility for quality, works in a structured and disciplined manner, and communicates clearly. You value accuracy, reliability, and continuous improvement in everything you do.

We offer

We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture, and a strong work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to work in a growing and future-oriented sector, contributing to high-impact digital solutions. We provide a hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working, and we believe in curiosity and continuous learning as technology evolves.

Location: Asunción, Paraguay (Hybrid)

We perform background checks on all final candidates. Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Se você é um Fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

  • Advanced English proficiency (C1+)

Queremos transformar o jeito que as pessoas compram e se relacionam com seus óculos de grau, porque achamos que dessa maneira, melhoramos não somente como elas se veem, mas também como se relacionam com o mundo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Identificar, analisar e apurar oportunidades de créditos tributários nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, garantindo aderência à legislação vigente;
  • Conduzir estudos e análises para recuperação de créditos tributários, incluindo elaboração de memórias de cálculo, relatórios técnicos e suporte à escrituração;
  • Desenvolver e apoiar a implementação de estratégias de planejamento tributário, visando a otimização da carga tributária e a mitigação de riscos fiscais;
  • Acompanhar alterações na legislação tributária, incluindo a Reforma, avaliando impactos e propondo adequações nos processos e estratégias fiscais da companhia;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva junto às áreas internas (contábil, fiscal, jurídico e negócios), orientando quanto aos impactos tributários das operações;
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos tributários, identificando oportunidades de eficiência e automação.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação completa em Ciências Contábeis, Administração ou área correlacionadas;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Planejamento Tributário e/ou Reforma Tributária;
  • Conhecimento sólido na área tributária, com atuação em planejamento tributário e levantamento/recuperação de créditos tributários;
  • Vivência em análise da legislação tributária e aplicação prática em operações do ramo de varejo;
  • Ter atuado em planejamento tributário e levantamento/recuperação de créditos tributários;
  • Conhecimento específico em planejamento tributário e apuração de créditos tributários.

Soft Skills

  • Perfil analítico e pensamento estratégico;
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara e objetiva com diferentes áreas;
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e gestão de prazos;
  • Proatividade, autonomia e senso crítico;
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e com múltiplas demandas.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Excel em nível avançado;
  • Experiência com TOTVS;
  • Experiência na elaboração de estudos técnicos, pareceres e memórias de cálculo.

title: Managing Consultant, Customer Success
description:
Overview

Company Overview
Libryo, an ERM Group Company, is a global SaaS platform that empowers multinational organizations to understand and comply with Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) law and broader ESG requirements. Our platform helps customers navigate complex regulatory environments with clarity and precision. Founded in 2016 and now part of ERM, the world’s largest pure-play sustainability consultancy, Libryo combines technology with legal expertise to support organizations in achieving operational excellence and legal certainty.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) with strong strategic account management expertise to grow a portfolio of customers in North America and Latin America (NA/LATAM). This is a mid-to-senior-level role with potential people management responsibilities. This individual will lead customer implementations, drive platform adoption, and be accountable for renewal outcomes, customer growth opportunities, and relationship longevity. You’ll work across departments to deliver a high-quality experience that aligns with each customer’s business and regulatory objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Regional Account Ownership (NA & LATAM)
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for all assigned customers in North and Latin America.
    • Build and maintain strategic relationships with senior stakeholders, user groups, and decision-makers across large multinational organizations.
    • Represent the voice of the customer internally to ensure customer needs are heard and prioritized.
  • Customer Implementations
    • Lead end-to-end delivery of customer onboarding and implementation projects, coordinating with internal teams (e.g., Legal Content, RIDE, and Product) to deliver on time and to spec.
    • Work with key stakeholders to map customer-specific rollouts (global or phased), track milestones, communicate progress with customers, and resolve blockers proactively.
    • Contribute to implementation playbooks and best practice guides to scale future delivery.
  • Renewal & Retention Management
    • Take full ownership of renewal planning and execution, including pricing alignment, contract coordination, and commercial positioning for their allocated customer portfolio and region.
    • Monitor and improve customer health and adoption through data, feedback, and regular business reviews.
    • Anticipate and mitigate risks that could lead to churn through proactive engagement and problem-solving.
  • Strategic Account Growth
    • Identify and support growth opportunities, including cross-sell, upsell, and feature expansion across accounts.
    • Support proposal creation and commercial scoping efforts in collaboration with relevant stakeholders to enable account expansion.
    • Track and report on account growth potential using insights from platform engagement, stakeholder behavior, and evolving needs.
  • Platform Mastery & Support
    • As a senior member of the Customer Success team, develop deep expertise across Libryo’s full suite of tools, including the Libryo Platform, Libryo Research, and ERM Assess. Deliver high-level support and guidance to users, ensuring seamless navigation, adoption, and troubleshooting across all platforms. Play a key role in ensuring a consistent, professional, and high-quality user experience across every touchpoint, reinforcing Libryo’s reputation for excellence and reliability in regulatory technology.
  • Team Collaboration & Cross-Functional Coordination
    • Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Legal, Product, Support, Customer Intelligence) to ensure each customer receives seamless, aligned service.
    • Participate in customer health reviews, product feedback loops, and ongoing support escalations when needed.
    • May manage and mentor junior Customer Success team members, contributing to team strategy and development.
  • Customer Reporting & Communication
    • Deliver Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with strategic insight, platform metrics, and tailored recommendations.
    • Maintain CRM hygiene in HubSpot, ensuring accurate tracking of org structures, usage data, and renewal timelines.
    • Provide input to internal reporting (e.g., churn forecasting, customer health scores, and CS dashboards).
  • Experience & Qualifications
    • Fluent in English (additional languages is a huge plus, particularly Spanish).
    • Bachelor's degree in business, legal, environmental sciences, or a related discipline. A legal background is a strong advantage.
    • 5+ years of customer success/account management experience in a B2B SaaS, compliance, legal-tech, or ESG space.
    • Demonstrated success managing strategic enterprise accounts and driving customer growth and renewals.
    • Proven ability to lead complex customer implementations, manage cross-functional projects, and navigate senior stakeholder relationships.
    • Exposure to international accounts, with an understanding of NA/LATAM business contexts and cultural nuance.
    • Strong command of HubSpot, Salesforce, ClickUp, Excel/Sheets, and reporting/BI tools (PowerBI is a plus).
    • Experience managing or mentoring junior team members or working in a leadership pod structure.

What Success Looks Like

  • Highest quality of work delivered
  • High engagement and satisfaction across assigned customer accounts.
  • Successful and on-time delivery of all customer onboarding and implementation projects.
  • Clear account growth paths identified and supported with strategic input.
  • Renewals closed predictably and proactively with limited commercial risk.
  • Clean, current data and insight-driven QBRs shared with customers and leadership.

Platform Expertise & Training

Develop deep knowledge of the Libryo platform and associated tools to support effective onboarding, training, and engagement. Deliver live training sessions and contribute to documentation, including Knowledge Base content for customer self-service.

Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement

Assist in collecting and analyzing customer feedback and reviewing internal workflows to improve the end-to-end customer journey. Help refine internal operational processes to improve delivery consistency, reduce friction, and ensure high-quality service across customer segments.

Thank you for your interest in ERM!

title: Quality Control Inspector
description:
About the Role


The Service Provider will be providing QC services at WAG (Water Alternate Gas) manifolds worksite based in Rio, Brazil with frequent travel within to Distrito Industrial – Vespasiano/MG Brasil. You will be responsible to ensure that Contractor (CTR) supplies WAG Manifold and Foundations on-time as per the clients HSE policies and with satisfactory & required level of quality.


The Service Provider will liaise with CPY Subsea HSE Lead, CPY Quality Lead, CPY Materials & Welding Lead and CPY Delivery Lead.



HSE and Compliance



  • Fully comply with site security, health and safety instructions, stay vigilant and maintain continuous awareness of hazards and surroundings.

  • Will be accountable for demonstrating, individually, an exemplary behaviour regarding HSE rules & requirements, including trainings, and enforcing HSE execution decisions/directions taken by CPY Subsea HSE Lead.

  • Report any issue/anomalies (using system in place in the facility) and to make use of TOTAL STOP WORK policy as necessary.

  • Ensure that risk assessments are performed as and when necessary, that management of change is adhered to and that tool-box talks are conducted efficiently.

  • Adopt and demonstrate exemplary behaviour regarding Company Ethics and “Code of Conduct” policy and promote the re-enforcement of the Anti-Corruption Program.


WORK TASKS


The Service holder will be responsible to control that the work performed by CTR and sub-CTR is in line with CPY and Project Specifications for WAG Manifolds and Foundations in terms of Quality.


For all these tasks, the incumbent will be requested:



  • To conduct thorough inspections of welds and welding processes to ensure compliance with applicable WPS/PQR, codes, standards, and specifications, have ability to conduct welding inspection before, during and after as per ISO 3834-2 requirements

  • To have ability to conduct welding inspection before, during and after as per ISO 3834-2 requirements

  • To have extensive inspection knowledge and experience (min 10 years) in CRA materials such as Super duplex (Pipe/Forging and HIPPED), Inconel 625 and LAS (F22)

  • To have excellent inspection experience in buttering, overlay and girth welding of Inconel 625 and Alloy 59 consumables

  • To utilize advanced inspection techniques including visual, ultrasonic, Phase Array Ultrasonic Testing (PAUT), magnetic particle, Liquid penetrant Inspection and radiographic testing to assess weld quality as per ASME/DNV code requirements

  • To have ability to interpret welding procedure specifications (WPS) and procedure qualification records (PQR) to validate conformance at site during production

  • To have the ability to perform inspection on incoming production materials against requirements and mill certificates

  • To participate in root cause analysis for welding defects and development of corrective action plans in collaboration with project welding engineer and site production teams

  • To identify and raise subsequent comments highlight deviations, unacceptable or unjustified quality issues related but not limited to Welding that could affect SPS equipment during fabrication, installation, and production at site

  • To prepare detailed inspection reports and documentation for compliance on weekly basis

  • To collaborate with Company Site Rep and CPY material engineer on any welding/NDT/material issues at site

  • To stop the work in case of non-conformity and re-assess the situation before resuming To discuss with contractor/sub-contractors in case of issues/unconformity during the control program, to look for acceptable solutions in order not to penalize the delivery schedule but still fulfilling the quality standards set by the contract

  • To ensure that unconformities are driven towards closure in a timely manner (i.e. without impacting the delivery schedule)

  • To follow up site welding activities and provide feedback to project team

  • To participate to COMPANY and contractor audits and follow up closure of identified issues


About You


You are a highly experienced welding and quality professional with a strong background in subsea structures and WAG manifolds. You bring more than 15 years of hands-on experience in welding inspection, with deep technical knowledge of welding processes, materials, and offshore fabrication requirements.


You hold a recognized Welding Inspector certification such as CSWIP 3.1 or 3.2 (or equivalent) and are certified to Level 3 in multiple Non-Destructive Testing methods, including Ultrasonic Testing (UT/PAUT), Radiography (RT), and Dye Penetrant Inspection (DPI).


You are confident in interpreting complex engineering drawings, technical specifications, and welding documentation, and you are known for your strong analytical skills and ability to investigate root causes and resolve challenging quality issues in fast-paced project environments.


You communicate clearly and professionally in English, with additional language skills in Portuguese or French considered an advantage.

Job description

Main responsibilities

  • Executar procedimentos que podem ser programados, eventuais, físicos ou lógicos que envolvam rondas, reboots de equipamentos, extrações de logs, crimpagem ou passagem de cabos, controle da geração de relatórios de acompanhamento, entre outros, sempre devidamente documentados e dentro do respectivo nível de acesso;
  • Garantir sempre no mínimo um operador dedicado monitorando as consoles de cada site e recursos suficientes para, em paralelo, atender atividades que exijam deslocamentos para fora da sala de operações.
  • Alguns serviços de operação exigem deslocamento, no mesmo site ou em sites diferentes na mesma localidade. Exemplo: Rondas nos Data centers para verificação visual e auditiva de equipamentos no ambiente.
  • Abrir chamados de incidentes, interagir com as equipes definidas pela Oi para solicitar o escalonamento de incidentes e solicitações com impacto nos níveis de serviço;
  • Operar os consoles de alarmes, monitoração e “trouble ticket” definidos pela Oi, documentando, conforme “templates” definidos nesses consoles, as ações tomadas, gerando assim a realimentação da base de conhecimento;
  • Participação e comunicação junto a fornecedores e clientes (e‑mail, voz e vídeo).
  • Gerar documentação dos serviços prestados, dos indicadores de níveis de serviço e manter atualizadas as documentações, processos e procedimentos utilizados pelas equipes de Operação Data Center.
  • Acompanhar e fornecer acessos para clientes e fornecedores que necessitem adentrar as áreas internas do Data Center, auxiliando-os e orientando‑os quanto aos procedimentos e autorizações vigentes;
  • Coordenar atividades relacionadas ao processo de Gestão de Mudanças quando as mesmas forem do escopo da Operação Data Center (Hardware/equipamentos de DC) negociando com as áreas envolvidas, planejamento, execução e acompanhamento das atividades técnicas para os atendimentos em manutenções de hardware.
  • Movimentar mídias de backup entre os diversos ambientes externos (cofres e sites externos) e entre os robôs.
  • Fazer a instalação e desinstalação física de equipamentos dentro do Data Center.
  • O PROPONENTE fica responsável também pelo deslocamento interno e organização dos equipamentos dentro do Data Center. Exemplos de deslocamentos entre áreas:
  1. Área de Descarga para Sala de Estoque;
  2. Área de Descarga para Data Hall;
  3. Sala de Estoque para Data Hall;
  4. Data hall para Sala de Estoque;
  5. Salas de Estoque;
  • Realizar atividades gerais de apoio às outras áreas, como: localizar equipamentos nas salas, acompanhar clientes, auditorias no Data Center, verificar configuração de hardware, executar procedimentos, atuando como “remote‑hands” dentro do Data Center, entre outras atividades, não se limitando a estas;
  • Executar atividades de ronda periodicamente de acordo com procedimentos estabelecidos junto ao contratante;
  • Controlar fisicamente, através dos processos de Gestão de Configuração e de Ativos, o recebimento, saída, e posição de equipamentos nos Data centers (racks, depósitos, docas, salas de embalagem / desembalagem, etc.), checando toda a documentação fiscal.
  • Coordenar atividades junto às transportadoras, garantindo a entrega fim‑a‑fim dos equipamentos;
  • Acompanhar mudanças no ambiente, quando envolverem atividades de infraestrutura física e cabeamento, entre outras, mesmo que ocorram fora do horário comercial;
  • Realizar inspeções periódicas nos Datacenters com o objetivo de verificar se os itens de infraestrutura predial, tais como limpeza, instalações físicas, insumos relacionados a execução dos serviços e organização dos ambientes, adequando‑os às políticas da empresa Oi;

description:
O Coordenador de Operações de Transportes é responsável por coordenar e supervisionar todas as operações do contrato garantindo que sejam executadas de forma eficiente. Planejar e otimizar cada processo pois o objetivo é maximizar a eficiência operacional e minimizar custos. Os indicadores de desempenho são também sob sua responsabilidade, devendo assim acompanhar essas métricas, identificar áreas de melhoria e implementar ações corretivas para otimizar os resultados. Além disso, é o representante DeLuna como ponto de contato entre a empresa, fornecedores e clientes. Outro aspecto importante é a construção de um ambiente de trabalho positivo e colaborativo, que é essencial para o sucesso organizacional. Estabelecer uma visão compartilhada, construir um ambiente de trabalho positivo, atribuir tarefas de forma equilibrada, incentivar o desenvolvimento dos membros da equipe e demonstrar habilidades de resolução de conflitos e tomada de decisões.

Competências necessárias :

  • Excelentes habilidades de liderança e comunicação;
  • Proatividade e capacidade de resolver problemas de forma eficiente;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e tomar decisões rápidas;
  • Atenção aos detalhes e alto nível de organização;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e colaborar com diferentes áreas da empresa;
  • Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade para lidar com mudanças e novos desafios.

As principais Responsabilidades incluem:

  • Elaborar Planos de Ações para garantir resultados pactuados no Planejamento Estratégico Empresarial;
  • Acompanhar Indicadores de Desempenho, elaborar processos para melhoria contínua, garantir execução;
  • Assegurar a gestão, implementação e treinamento dos Procedimentos Operacionais;
  • Coordenar Operações Logísticas, bem como projetos e implementações de novas Operações;
  • Garantir resultados pactuados com o Cliente, elevando o nível de serviços e satisfação por meio de alta performance e gestão. Realizar atendimento direto ao Cliente com propósito de melhorar e expandir continuamente as operações de transportes;
  • Maximizar a rentabilidade das operações, acompanhar orçamento e controle agindo para garantir os resultados financeiros pactuados, gerindo processo de perdas e eliminando prejuízos operacionais;
  • Fazer Gestão Estratégica de Pessoas para que todos gerem resultados, buscando o processo de crescimento por meio da evolução dos Colaboradores.
  • Treinar, acompanhar e monitorar desempenho dos Colaboradores da área de Operações: Supervisores, Líderes, Encarregados e Dispatchers. Implementar rotina de Gestão.
  • Fazer Gestão de Relacionamento com os Prestadores de Serviços de Transportes, garantindo a implementação da cultura e requisitos da organização;
  • Acompanhando e auxiliar o processo de captação e retenção de Prestadores;
  • Realizar as Reuniões Matinais com os Prestadores de Serviços.

A Formação necessária para essa função é Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Logística, Engenharia ou afins. Desejável pós-graduação.

Os Conhecimentos necessários são:

  • Experiência comprovada em planejamento estratégico, gestão de operações logísticas e transportes, sendo um diferencial vivência em Last Mile e/ou E-Commerce;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão de transporte (TMS) e ferramentas de rastreamento;
  • Habilidade em análise de dados e geração de relatórios de performance;
  • Conhecimento das regulamentações e normas de segurança no transporte de mercadorias;
  • Capacidade de planejamento e organização para gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e prioridades.

Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. As an implementations specialist, you will become an equity expert and use that knowledge to implement our clients onto the Carta software, setting them up for long‑term success. You will work to:

  • Establish strong customer relationships and inspire long‑term loyalty by providing a high quality and timely on‑boarding process as the first service provider post‑sale
  • Migrate and maintain the quality of clients data to Carta’s Onboarding Spreadsheet in Excel
  • Coordinate and manage inputs needed from both the clients and their law firms
  • Train clients on how to use Carta Software: you feel comfortable working with data, business systems, and developing training content for our customers
  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on‑boarding process
  • Work closely with product, engineering and our internal implementations leaders to improve the experience for our customers

The Team You’ll Work With

Carta is looking for an Implementation Specialist to join our Rio SMB/MM Team as part of our larger Delivery team. Our Delivery team members have grown to become some of the strongest contributors in our company due to their thorough understanding of our software, customers, and the business value we deliver. Ideal candidates will have a strong passion for financial services, building customer relationships, project delivery, and analytical problem solving.

About You:

  • You’re proficient in Excel and have experience with CRMs (preferably Salesforce)
  • You’re eager to learn or have experience working with: Mixmax, Talkdesk, and Guru
  • You have strong project management and organization skills – must be able to manage multiple on‑boardings (40+) at a time
  • You are familiar with or will become familiar with Private Equity and Capitalization
  • You have great people skills and a high degree of empathy
  • You have the ability to work cross‑functionally with teams
  • You embrace change and constantly seek ways to better your process and your team
  • You possess a helpful and professional attitude and can exhibit diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues
  • Knowledge of finance and accounting is a plus
  • Experience working at a high‑growth software company is a plus

  • We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email.

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Listen to members, learn and translate that cross functionally so our team can focus on the improvements that matter most to members. Your speciality is providing the best level of service in written Portuguese and English. You know when to spot a bug, irregularity on the app and improvements based on customer feedback.

You naturally provide the highest level of service and keep the members best interest in mind.

  • You have a flexible mindset when it comes to working hours. Being able to jump in and help colleagues at busy times, work during the non‑conventional hours such as evenings and weekends.

About Inner Circle

Inner Circle is a high‑quality dating app that focuses on getting you offline. To make sure your time is well spent, the team behind the app screens each member on safety, effort and mindset so you only see rich profiles from people you'd actually want to go on a date with. With a community of 3.5 million singles in 27 countries around the world, we help you match based on values and interests, making it easier to meet.

The independent bootstrapped tech company ranked in the FT list as one of the fastest‑growing companies in Europe. The company was also the winner of Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50 in The Netherlands in 2018.

At Inner Circle, we embrace our diverse community and team. We celebrate differences and know that they are key for helping us grow. Whatever your race, religion, colour, gender, national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability or age, we make sure everyone has the space to be themselves.

title: Technical Services Senior Manager
description:
Technical Services Senior Manager

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Technical Services Senior Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, coordination, and delivery of all technical services across tournament venues, ensuring full alignment with FIFA requirements and international standards. The role leads the integration and operational readiness of venue infrastructure services including power systems (grid, overlay, and backup), containment, water and waste, HVAC, and broadcast technical support across stadiums, training sites, and non-competition venues.

The position oversees the planning, execution, and supervision of technical services and infrastructure operations, managing power contractors and key suppliers, coordinating containment planning, and leading stadium technical inspections and independent audits. Working closely with internal teams, Host Cities, Stadium Authorities, service providers, and other stakeholders, the role ensures technical compliance, cross-functional alignment, and delivery excellence while maintaining timelines, budgets, and quality benchmarks.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate closely with key Functional Areas to define, refine, and validate technical services requirements, including power, containment, water and waste, HVAC, and floodlighting, across stadiums, training sites, and non-competition venues.
  • Lead coordination with Host Cities, Stadium Authorities, power contractors, utility providers, and suppliers to ensure seamless planning, integration, and delivery of power solutions.
  • Support and contribute to procurement activities, including preparation of technical inputs for RFPs, participation in tendering processes, technical evaluations, and coordination with contracted suppliers and delivery partners.
  • Oversee the development, implementation, and performance of power infrastructure, including grid, overlay, and backup systems, ensuring alignment with FIFA standards and operational requirements.
  • Manage containment planning and execution, ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient routing for power, broadcast, and other technical services.
  • Monitor progress, quality, and compliance of technical services works, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and mitigation measures.
  • Coordinate stadium technical inspections, readiness reviews, and independent technical audits, ensuring timely closure of findings and follow-up actions.
  • Ensure full compliance with FIFA technical guidelines and international standards, while balancing operational needs, timelines, budgets, and quality benchmarks.
  • Act as the central technical interface between Functional Areas, suppliers, and external stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, alignment, and decision-making.
  • Support procurement, contracting, and supplier performance management related to power, MEP and technical services, including scope definition and technical evaluation.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned and driving standardization and best practices across venues.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical or engineering field
  • A minimum of 8 years work experience in a technical services related field within Major Events/Sports Organization
  • Experience with Energy / MEP required (e.g. Temporary Power, Ventilation and Cooling, Cabling)
  • Strong technical knowledge in Energy / MEP required (e.g. Temporary Power, Ventilation and Cooling, Cabling, Entertainment)
  • Proficient in MS Office and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
  • Availability to travel as needed

title: Brazil - Remote: Front-end Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Complexity: Rendering massive tables and managing strict validation logic for mission-critical data pipelines.
  • Interactivity: Building conversational UIs (streaming chat) and high-performance time-series dashboards that update in real-time.
  • Visualization: Designing intuitive interfaces for Data Lineage, Knowledge Graphs, and Entity Mapping.

You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, ensuring design consistency across the platform while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • Component Architecture: Create a reusable, strictly typed Angular component library that scales across AI, Dashboard, and Admin modules.
  • Performance: Optimize change detection strategies and virtual scrolling to ensure the UI remains responsive and performant, whether rendering a live data stream or a 3D object.
  • Data-Driven Design: Handle complex JSON schemas and heavy payloads, ensuring data precision from API to UI

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Data Platform & Management Tools

  • Build Management Interfaces: Develop the "Control Room" for Data Engineers, including Data Catalog and Pipeline Configuration screens.
  • Heuristics & Mapping: Create efficient workflows for "Entity Matching" that allow users to visually map raw sensor tags to physical assets.
  • Visualizing Lineage: Implement DAG visualizations (D3.js or similar) to allow users to trace data asset layers and dependencies.

AI Interfaces & Visualization

  • Build AI Assistant UI: Develop rich conversational interfaces that support streaming responses (SSE), markdown rendering, and interactive "artifacts".
  • Advanced Dashboarding: Implement high-performance time-series charts using Plotly.js, ensuring smooth zooming/panning on large datasets.
  • Document Handling: Develop integrated viewers for PDF documents and rich media, allowing Agents to cite sources visually.

The Technology Stack

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Framework: Angular 16+ (Expert level), TypeScript, RxJS.
  • State Management: NgRx or Signals.
  • Visualization: Plotly.js (Time-series), D3.js/DAGs (Lineage).
  • API Integration: REST APIs (FastAPI), Server-Sent Events (SSE), WebSockets (using Socket.io)

Qualifications

  • Component Architect: You write clean, decoupled components and understand how to build a UI kit that scales.
  • UX Sensibility: You understand that a "Chat" interface needs to feel immediate and care about loading states and smooth transitions.
  • You take pride in building tools that make other engineers productive, caring deeply about workflow efficiency and keyboard shortcuts.

Must Haves

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 5+ years of experience in Frontend Development (Angular focus).
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and reactive programming patterns.
  • Experience building Admin Dashboards, B2B SaaS interfaces, or complex SPAs.
  • Ability to handle complex API integrations and data modeling on the client side.
  • Advanced English communication skills

Good To Have

  • Visualization: Hands-on experience with Plotly.js, D3.js, or Lineage/DAG graphs.
  • AI/Chat: Experience building Chat/LLM interfaces and handling streaming text.
  • Data Heavy: Familiarity with high-performance libraries and virtual scrolling.
  • Media/Geo: Experience with PDF rendering in-browser or Map/GIS libraries (Leaflet, Mapbox).

title: Managing Consultant, Customer Success
description:
Company Overview

Libryo, an ERM Group Company, is a global SaaS platform that empowers multinational organizations to understand and comply with Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) law and broader ESG requirements. Our platform helps customers navigate complex regulatory environments with clarity and precision. Founded in 2016 and now part of ERM, the world’s largest pure‑play sustainability consultancy, Libryo combines technology with legal expertise to support organizations in achieving operational excellence and legal certainty.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) with strong strategic account management expertise to grow a portfolio of customers in North America and Latin America (NA/LATAM). This is a mid‑to‑senior‑level role with potential people management responsibilities. This individual will lead customer implementations, drive platform adoption, and be accountable for renewal outcomes, customer growth opportunities, and relationship longevity. You’ll work across departments to deliver a high‑quality experience that aligns with each customer’s business and regulatory objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Regional Account Ownership (NA & LATAM)

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all assigned customers in North and Latin America.
  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with senior stakeholders, user groups, and decision‑makers across large multinational organizations.
  • Represent the voice of the customer internally to ensure customer needs are heard and prioritized.

Customer Implementations

  • Lead end‑to‑end delivery of customer onboarding and implementation projects, coordinating with internal teams (e.g., Legal Content, RIDE, and Product) to deliver on time and to spec.
  • Work with key stakeholders to map customer‑specific rollouts (global or phased), track milestones, communicate progress with customers, and resolve blockers proactively.
  • Contribute to implementation playbooks and best practice guides to scale future delivery.

Renewal & Retention Management

  • Take full ownership of renewal planning and execution, including pricing alignment, contract coordination, and commercial positioning for their allocated customer portfolio and region.
  • Monitor and improve customer health and adoption through data, feedback, and regular business reviews.
  • Anticipate and mitigate risks that could lead to churn through proactive engagement and problem‑solving.

Strategic Account Growth

  • Identify and support growth opportunities, including cross‑sell, upsell, and feature expansion across accounts.
  • Support proposal creation and commercial scoping efforts in collaboration with relevant stakeholders to enable account expansion.
  • Track and report on account growth potential using insights from platform engagement, stakeholder behavior, and evolving needs.

Platform Mastery & Support

  • As a senior member of the Customer Success team, you will be expected to develop deep expertise across Libryo’s full suite of tools, including the Libryo Platform, Libryo Research, and ERM Assess. This role requires you to deliver high‑level support and guidance to users, ensuring seamless navigation, adoption, and troubleshooting across all platforms. You’ll play a key role in ensuring a consistent, professional, and high‑quality user experience across every touchpoint, reinforcing Libryo’s reputation for excellence and reliability in regulatory technology.

Team Collaboration & Cross‑Functional Coordination

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Legal, Product, Support, Customer Intelligence) to ensure each customer receives seamless, aligned service.
  • Participate in customer health reviews, product feedback loops, and ongoing support escalations when needed.
  • May manage and mentor junior Customer Success team members, contributing to team strategy and development.

Customer Reporting & Communication

  • Deliver Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with strategic insight, platform metrics, and tailored recommendations.
  • Maintain CRM hygiene in HubSpot, ensuring accurate tracking of org structures, usage data, and renewal timelines.
  • Provide input to internal reporting (e.g., churn forecasting, customer health scores, and CS dashboards).

Experience & Qualifications

  • Fluent in English (additional languages is a huge plus, particularly Spanish)
  • Bachelor's degree in business, legal, environmental sciences, or a related discipline. A legal background is a strong advantage.
  • 5+ years of customer success/account management experience in a B2B SaaS, compliance, legal‑tech, or ESG space.
  • Demonstrated success managing strategic enterprise accounts and driving customer growth and renewals.
  • Proven ability to lead complex customer implementations, manage cross‑functional projects, and navigate senior stakeholder relationships.
  • Exposure to international accounts, with an understanding of NA/LATAM business contexts and cultural nuance.
  • Strong command of HubSpot, Salesforce, ClickUp, Excel/Sheets, and reporting/BI tools (PowerBI is a plus).
  • Experience managing or mentoring junior team members or working in a leadership pod structure.

What Success Looks Like

  • Highest quality of work delivered
  • High engagement and satisfaction across assigned customer accounts.
  • Successful and on‑time delivery of all customer onboarding and implementation projects.
  • Clear account growth paths identified and supported with strategic input.
  • Renewals closed predictably and proactively with limited commercial risk.
  • Clean, current data and insight‑driven QBRs shared with customers and leadership.

Platform Expertise & Training

Develop deep knowledge of the Libryo platform and associated tools to support effective onboarding, training, and engagement. Deliver live training sessions and contribute to documentation, including Knowledge Base content for customer self‑service.

Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement

Assist in collecting and analyzing customer feedback and reviewing internal workflows to improve the end‑to‑end customer journey. Help refine internal operational processes to improve delivery consistency, reduce friction, and ensure high‑quality service across customer segments.

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set‑up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high‑quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large‑scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament‑time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.

  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑The‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large‑scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large‑scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi‑stakeholder and multicultural environments.

  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast‑paced environment.

  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired

  • Apresentar ao investidor ou a marca, todo o processo de administração, operações (projetos, obras, segurança, limpeza) e marketing, visando o conhecimento do modelo do shopping, sempre mantendo contato com a área comercial.
  • Participar do processo de acompanhamento da obra da loja e sua inauguração, mantendo sempre excelente relacionamento com o cliente, visando possíveis negócios futuros.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.

A área de IAM é responsável por garantir que cada pessoa e sistema tenha o acesso certo, no momento certo e apenas ao que precisa, usando ferramentas como Entra ID, Active Directory e SailPoint. Ela cuida de todo o ciclo de vida do usuário, desde a criação da conta, mudanças de função, até o desligamento, além de controlar acessos, autenticações e integrações com sistemas internos e SaaS.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Operar e dar suporte ao ambiente de Identidade e Acesso;

  • Acompanhar e corrigir falhas de provisionamento e desprovisionamento;
  • Apoiar criação, alteração e remoção de acessos no MS Entra ID, Active Directory, SailPoint e aplicações integradas;
  • Executar e acompanhar os fluxos de Joiner, Mover e Leaver;

  • Testar e validar integrações via SCIM e APIs usando Postman;

  • Documentar/atualizar processos;
  • Apoiar na governança.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD);
  • Experiência com Active Directory (on-premises e híbrido);
  • Experiência com SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC);
  • Conhecimento em Identity Lifecycle Management (Joiner, Mover, Leaver);
  • Conhecimento em processos de provisionamento e desprovisionamento de contas e acessos;
  • Conhecimento em RBAC (controle de acesso baseado em papéis);
  • Noções de auditoria de acessos, revisões e compliance (SoD, Least Privilege);
  • Experiência com Postman para testes e validação de integrações.

Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:

  • Conhecimento em SCIM;
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST, JSON e Web Services;
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de autenticação e autorização (OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0 e OpenID Connect);
  • Experiência com ferramentas ITSM, como Freshservice;
  • Conhecimento em PowerShell e/ou Python;
  • Experiência com Logic Apps e Azure Functions;
  • Conhecimento em Azure Key Vault (AKV) para gestão de segredos, credenciais e tokens;
  • Conhecimento em workflows, rules e transforms no SailPoint ISC;
  • Experiência com integração de aplicações corporativas e SaaS;
  • Noções de segurança em APIs;
  • Certificações em IAM, Cloud ou Segurança da Informação.

QUEM SOMOS

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas , de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos.

Diversidade e inclusão

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência.   • Atuar na sustentação : correção de bugs, investigação com logs/crash reports e prevenção de regressões.
  • Participar de code reviews (recebendo e contribuindo), refinamentos, estimativas e cerimônias do time (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Colaborar com backend, produto e design para alinhamento de requisitos e contratos de integração.
  • Apoiar a evolução de observabilidade no app (Crashlytics, Analytics, Feature Flags, Remote Config e métricas básicas).
  • Contribuir com documentação técnica, boas práticas de desenvolvimento

Requisitos e qualificações

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS:

  • Experiência prática com Flutter e Dart (profissional ou equivalente que comprove entregas reais).
  • Experiência consumindo APIs REST e integrando com serviços externos.
  • Experiência com recursos modernos da linguagem Dart e programação assíncrona (Futures, Streams, async/await).
  • Vivência com ferramentas da Firebase Suite: Crashlytics e Remote Config.
  • Conhecimento de Git e rotina de pull request/code review (mesmo que com apoio).
  • Noções sólidas de qualidade : organização de código, tratamento de erros e atenção a performance.
  • Conhecimento básico de testes em Flutter (unit/widget) e boas práticas de desenvolvimento mobile.

DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência com arquitetura no Flutter (Clean Architecture, MVVM, etc.).
  • Implementação de Design System proprietário, componentes reutilizáveis, tematização
  • Conhecimento de Firebase (Crashlytics, Analytics, Remote Config, Push).
  • Experiência com CI/CD mobile (Fastlane, Bitrise, GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps).
  • Noções de observabilidade e monitoramento em apps.
  • Experiência com app em produção (mesmo que em menor escala).

The Mindrift platform, launched and powered by Toloka, connects domain experts with cutting‑edge AI projects from innovative tech clients. Our mission is to unlock the potential of GenAI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for curious and intellectually proactive contributors, the kind of person who double‑checks assumptions and plays devil’s advocate. Are you comfortable with ambiguity and complexity? Does an async, remote, flexible opportunity sound exciting? Would you like to learn how modern AI systems are tested and evaluated?

  • Analysts, researchers, or consultants with strong critical thinking skills
  • Students (senior undergrads / grad students) looking for an intellectually interesting gig

We’re on the hunt for QAs for autonomous AI agents for a new project focused on validating and improving complex task structures, policy logic, and agent evaluation frameworks. Throughout the project, you’ll have to balance quality assurance, research, and logical problem‑solving. This project opportunity is ideal for people who enjoy looking at systems holistically and thinking through scenarios, implications, and edge cases.

You do not need a coding background, but you must be curious, intellectually rigorous, and capable of evaluating the soundness and consistency of complex setups. If you’ve ever excelled in things like consulting, CHGK, Olympiads, case solving, or systems thinking — you might be a great fit.

  • Reviewing evaluation tasks and scenarios for logic, completeness, and realism
  • Identifying inconsistencies, missing assumptions, or unclear decision points
  • Helping define clear expected behaviors (gold standards) for AI agents
  • Annotating cause‑effect relationships, reasoning paths, and plausible alternatives
  • Thinking through complex systems and policies as a human would to ensure agents are tested properly
  • Working closely with QA, writers, or developers to suggest refinements or edge case coverage

How to Get Started

Apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to a project aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. Shape the future of AI while building tools that benefit everyone.

  • Excellent analytical thinking: Can reason about complex systems, scenarios, and logical implications

  • Ability to assess scenarios holistically: What’s missing, what’s unrealistic, what might break?
  • Good communication and clear writing (in English) to document your findings.

We also value applicants who have:

  • Experience with policy evaluation, logic puzzles, case studies, or structured scenario design
  • Background in consulting, academia, olympiads (e.g. logic/math/informatics), or research
  • Exposure to LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI‑generated content
  • Familiarity with QA or test‑case thinking (edge cases, failure modes, "what could go wrong")
  • Some understanding of how scoring or evaluation works in agent testing (precision, coverage, etc.)

Benefits

  • Take part in a flexible, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments
  • Participate in an advanced AI project and gain valuable experience to enhance your portfolio

title: Cleaning and Waste Cluster Coordinator FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC2027) hosted in South America in Brazil. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Cleaning and Waste Management Coordinator will support the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager in the planning, operational readiness, implementation, and monitoring of cleaning and waste management operations across FIFA Official Sites. The role supports waste minimisation by reviewing and assessing procurement and service contracts and contributes to achieving defined waste diversion targets.

The position is execution-focused and site-oriented, responsible for supporting readiness planning, coordinating day-to-day operations, and monitoring service delivery during test events and tournament operations. The CLW Coordinator plays a key role in translating strategic and functional requirements into practical, on-the-ground execution, ensuring operational continuity, compliance with FIFA requirements, and the timely identification and resolution of issues at the venue level.

The ideal candidate will combine expertise in event operations, sustainable cleaning, and waste management with strong project management skills. This role will focus on optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction, and minimizing environmental impact while adhering to FIFA’s stringent standards.

Key responsibilities

Planning & Operational Readiness

  • Support the development and readiness planning of cleaning and waste management operational plans across stadiums and other FIFA Official Sites.
  • Contribute to Service Level Agreement (SLA) development and alignment with Functional Area (FA) leads, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, operationally feasible, and venue-ready.
  • Support Service Level Requirement (SLR) alignment with stadium facility management teams, ensuring consistency with existing venue operations, infrastructure, and constraints.
  • Participate in readiness assessments, site walk-throughs, and test events to validate operational plans, staffing levels, infrastructure, and service flows.

Operational Coordination & Delivery

  • Coordinate day-to-day cleaning and waste management operations in line with approved operational plans, service levels, and schedules.
  • Support match-day, non-match-day, and peak-load operations to ensure service continuity and operational effectiveness.
  • Monitor contractor performance on site and report deviations, risks, and non-compliance to the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager.

Sustainable Waste Operations & Infrastructure

  • Support waste minimisation and waste diversion efforts through the correct implementation of waste streams and operational controls.
  • Assist in the deployment and operation of temporary waste management infrastructure, including interim collection points and resource recovery areas.
  • Monitor correct segregation and handling of waste streams and provide practical on-site guidance to teams and contractors.

Monitoring, Reporting & Issue Resolution

  • Conduct regular site inspections to assess operational readiness, cleanliness standards, and waste management performance.
  • Support data collection, basic reporting, and performance tracking against defined waste diversion targets.
  • Identify operational issues early and support escalation and resolution processes in coordination with the Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to post-event reviews, lessons learned, and continuous operational improvements.

Team & Contractor Coordination

  • Support on-site supervision and coordination of cleaning and waste management crews.
  • Assist with operational briefings, inductions, and coordination meetings.
  • Promote compliance with HSE requirements and safe working practices across all operations.

Your profile

  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in cleaning, waste management, facility operations, practical sustainability or event operations.
  • Experience of working at large-scale sporting events, major events, or complex multi-venue operations is strongly preferred.
  • Practical understanding of cleaning operations, sustainable upstream and downstream management of discarded materials, and contractor-based service delivery.
  • Experience coordinating service providers and working in live operational environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Facility Management, Environmental Management, Sustainability, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
  • Strong operational coordination and organisational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, high-pressure event environments.
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work across multiple stakeholders.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a hands-on, solution-oriented approach.
  • Good reporting and documentation skills.
  • Working knowledge of HSE principles related to cleaning and waste operations.
  • Willingness to travel extensively between FIFA Official Sites
  • Flexibility to work irregular hours, including match days and peak operational periods
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Software Alliance Ecosystem Manager
description:
The Software Alliances team at Canonical works with leading software companies to optimize and enable their products with Ubuntu and other Canonical software, for instance our AI offerings. We develop joint product roadmaps, drive delivery, and formulate go-to-market plans, content and processes, enabling differentiated offerings and robust product life-cycle support anchored to best-in-class Canonical products. Enterprises are able to receive the benefits of open source, securely maintained, and validated solutions from cloud to edge, whether purchased from Canonical, embedded in Alliance partners' products, or accessed through the cloud.

The successful candidate is someone who has a background in technology, engineering or product management and is interested in continuing to grow their career in business development. If you are someone who can navigate complex new technical challenges, learn quickly, and architect solutions and strategies across global teams, this challenging role is for you. This role is ideal for early career professionals with up to 7 years of experience.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the Americas or EMEA region.

The role entails

  • Collaborating with product, engineering, alliance and marketing teams at partners to align on open-source strategies.
  • Capturing partner requirements, evaluating gaps, and identifying Canonical opportunities.
  • Coordinating with marketing and product teams on messaging, content creation, and launch plans.
  • Creating partner- and customer-facing materials like reference architectures, joint blueprints, webinars, presentations, videos, and white papers.
  • Driving Ubuntu adoption within targeted alliance accounts, advocating its benefits to stakeholders and working with partners on enablement training for their development, delivery, support and commercial teams.
  • Influencing alliance partners to build with Canonical technology.
  • Up to 25% travel, including internationally, for internal conferences and to drive partnerships in person.

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.
  • Bachelor's degree in science, technology and/or engineering.
  • Experience in software development and system architecture.
  • Customer-facing experience in software engineering, product management, business development, technology strategy or similar functions.
  • Excellent communication skills across all levels of stakeholders - individual contributors to the C-suite; ability to grasp complex material and synthesize key points.
  • Ability to think and work at both strategic and tactical levels.
  • Disciplined and self motivated for a remote-first workplace environment.

Nice‑to‑have Skills And Experience

  • Experience with open source software and open source business models.
  • Team leadership, product management or program management experience.
  • Understanding of marketing and go-to-market strategy.
  • Sector-specific experience in finance, telecommunications, automotive, or public sectors.
  • Working knowledge of independent hardware and software vendor go-to-market motions.
  • Post‑graduate degree in science, technology or engineering field.

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipal, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Somos a Âmbar, a empresa de geração e comercialização de energia do grupo J&F, o maior grupo privado do Brasil. Nosso amplo portfólio de ativos contribui para a expansão e diversificação da matriz energética do Brasil.

Respaldados pela solidez do grupo J&F, atuamos na comercialização de energia no Mercado Livre e em projetos de Geração Distribuída para clientes em todo o Brasil. Atuamos na gestão completa das contas, criando soluções personalizadas para consumidores e empresas de todos os portes.

Presente em mais de 190 países e com 70 anos de história, o grupo J&F tem um portfólio amplo de empresas. Entre elas estão a JBS, líder global em alimentos à base de proteína, além da Eldorado Brasil Celulose, J&F Mineração, Flora Higiene e Cosméticos, Picpay, Banco Original e Canal Rural.

Estamos em busca de um Mecânico que irá executar a manutenção mecânica preventiva, preditiva e corretiva em todos os equipamentos da usina, conforme as ordens de serviços de manutenção originadas pelo programa anual de manutenção, bem como as solicitações das ocorrências diárias de manutenção, com o intuito de atingir as metas de disponibilidade dos equipamentos.

description:
VirtualResource (VR) is a boutique consultancy supporting companies to optimise their HR systems and Workday.

We strive to be the go-to company that partners with businesses to optimise their HR technology landscape.

What is the role about?

We are looking for an experienced Workday Integrations Developer with a strong Payroll integration experience (can be either integration with Workday Payroll or 3rd party Payroll systems), who is based in the Latin America time zone.

As a Workday Integrations Developer, you will design, build, and maintain integrations between Workday and Payroll systems, ensuring seamless data flow and accuracy. This role involves working closely with clients to understand requirements, troubleshoot issues, and optimise integration solutions to meet business needs. Your expertise will help clients maximise the efficiency of their Payroll operations through robust Workday integrations.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy Workday integrations for Payroll systems (Workday Payroll or third‑party systems).

  • Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues to ensure data accuracy and seamless functionality.
  • Conduct testing and validation of integrations, including error handling and edge cases.
  • Document integration processes, field mappings, and system workflows for future reference.
  • Work closely with cross‑functional teams, including HR, IT, and external vendors, to support Payroll operations.
  • Ensure compliance with data privacy, security, and organisational policies in all integration work.
  • Optimise and enhance existing integrations to improve performance and scalability.

What skills are we looking for?

Our roles are remotely based (even pre‑Covid), meaning you will be working from your home office, connecting with your client and team on a daily basis.

To be successful in this type of environment, you will need to have the ability to communicate effectively (in English) with cross‑functional teams, explain complex concepts in easy, understandable terms, align HR / business knowledge with Workday functionality, and proactively drive process improvements. You will need to be comfortable with video calls and be proactive in keeping communication channels open with your client and team.

Skills and Experience Required

  • 3 - 5 years’ Workday Integration and implementation experience including payroll integrations (either Workday Payroll and/or 3rd party payroll systems);
  • 5+ years of experience in the application of modern integration technologies (EDI, Web Services, XML, XSLT, Java, .Net, middleware).
  • Attention to detail and the ability to see the big picture, pragmatic problem solver.
  • Excellent planning, interpersonal and time management skills with a track record of following through on dedications.
  • Excellent technical communication skills are essential.
  • Fluent in English (writing, reading, and speaking).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (writing, reading, and speaking).
  • Ability to work independently and cross‑functionally.

Other Qualifications/Skills that will be beneficial but not mandatory

  • College or University Degree in HR or Information Systems.
  • Experience with any of the following: Java, JavaScript, .NET, XSLT, NetBeans IDE development background.
  • Experience in other critical corporate platform implementations such as Workday, Oracle, PeopleSoft, Sailpoint, SAP, Siebel, MuleSoft, Dellboomi, or applications built on AWS services.

As this is a remote role, you can be based anywhere in the Latin America region so long as you are authorised to work without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Our work model is hybrid and has cycles that can be from two to three months according to the business of expertise. For every eight or twelve weeks of remote work, one will be at the office. Check moreinformation here.
